item.title: Fascinating Rhythm: Original 1920s Songs Perfect Party Tunes - Past Perfect
item.description: Absolutely a delight! I play this CD over and over. Not only are the selections first-rate, but the re-mastering superb. All of the 78RPM "noise" is gone, yet the depth of sound remains. Clearly a labor of love.

item.title: Jazz Age: Hot 1920s & 30s Sounds 51 Tracks 2-CD Set - Past Perfect
item.description: Prime monuments of the Jazz Age and arguably, some of America’s finest jazz performances.

item.title: Fred Astaire: Classic Songs From The Movies 1930s & 40s - Past Perfect
item.description: Very pleased with this cd - good quality and a good price. Bought it for my 92 year old mum who likes to sing along in the car especially to the song we saw the sea.

item.title: La Vie Parisienne: French Chansons From The 1930s & 40s - Past Perfect
item.description: Beautifully remastered French Chansons From the 1930s & 40s Edith Piaf, Reinhardt & Grappelli

item.title: The Songs & Music of WW 2: Expertly Remastered 2 CD Set - Past Perfect
item.description: 5 stars! Lovely warmth songs to listen to on a Sunday with the family. Also, have studied about WWII during my studies, have also been attracted to WWII movies and games, and with these songs, it just always feels like I was there, always gives me goosebumps. Always have been an explorer my whole life. Cheers!

item.title: Perfect Swing: Lively Jazz Swing Bands Of The 1930s & 40s - Past Perfect
item.description: Excellent recording and it brings back great memories of the past. Thanks !

item.title: Great American Big Bands: From The 1930s & 40s - Past Perfect
item.description: The whole collection is of great music expertly reproduced and very enjoyable

item.title: Great British Dance Bands Of The 20s 30s & 40s: Halcyon Days - Past Perfect
item.description: Just listening to this excellent compilation took me back to a different time and place. It brought back a flood of wonderful memories. Thank you.

item.title: Words & Music Of Noel Coward: Songs From The 20s, 30s & 40s - Past Perfect
item.description: I've always liked Noel Coward's lyrics. This selection gives to the listener a good overview of his songs. Recommended! The download is in mp3 format, CD should sound a tad differently but nonetheless, Past Perfect's quality is instantly noticeable. I miss cover scans though. Thank you for your unique offer!
